name: MOISTURE ANALYZER BALANCE
desc: Microprocessor-Controlled High-Precision Digital Moisture Analyzer Balance engineered for rapid and reliable moisture determination. Features a maximum weighing capacity of 200g with an analytical readability of 0.001g, powered by a high-resolution EMFC Monotech sensor.
features: 200 g continuous analytical load spectrum layout
Integrated rapid Halogen SRA (Smart Radiation Attachment) and reflector
Internal logging tracking up to 4 User IDs, 40 distinct Methods, 100 Batches
High-speed integrated RS232, USB, and PS/2 data transfer interfaces

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Benchtop Digital Moisture Analyzer Balance
specifications.Core Measurement Application: Fast, precise sample moisture determination and solid mass tracking
specifications.Maximum Weighing Capacity: 200 g continuous analytical load spectrum layout
specifications.Primary Core Sensor Technology: Brilliant Monotech Electromagnetic Force Compensation (EMFC) Sensor
specifications.System Overload Protection: Built-in physical mechanical shield against accidental over-capacity loads
specifications.Drying Thermal Heating Source: Integrated rapid Halogen SRA (Smart Radiation Attachment) and reflector
specifications.Drying Operational Temp Range: Wide adjustable heating scale spanning from 30°C to 175°C
specifications.Optional Thermal Upgrades: Structural support configuration reaching up to 250°C heating boundaries
specifications.Thermal Drying Profile Modes: Versatile profiles: Standard, Gentle, Rapid, Steps, and High Temperature
specifications.Auto Switch-Off Selection Criteria: Programmable modes: Auto, Manual, Time-based, User-defined weight/time, User-defined %/time, and Intelligent cutoff
specifications.Testing Pan Dimension Layout: Round circular drying pan measuring exactly Ø 95 mm in diameter
specifications.System Security Parameters: Multi-level secure Password Protection module against unauthorized changes
specifications.Data Memory Storage Volume: Internal logging tracking up to 4 User IDs, 40 distinct Methods, 100 Batches, and up to 1000 analytical Results
specifications.Display Panel Dashboard: Bright backlit Graphical LCD display with wide viewing angle matrices
specifications.Data Synchronization Ports: High-speed integrated RS232, USB, and PS/2 data transfer interfaces
specifications.Regulatory Framework Quality: Stamped and fully compliant with GLP (Good Laboratory Practice), GMP, and SOP protocols
specifications.Calibration Diagnostics: Built-in Real-Time Clock (RTC) for accurate time-stamped testing data log rows
specifications.Enclosure Footprint Dimensions: Compact laboratory body sizing at 211 mm x 342 mm x 180 mm
specifications.Equipment Net Structural Mass: Main balance unit net weight tracking at exactly 5 Kg
specifications.Power Supply Requirements: Universal 230V AC / 50Hz stable single-phase Indian plug configuration
